purpose: WP25 build-time check: reachability, CORS headers and endpoint availability of the market-radar hosts (Binance USD-M futures REST, CFTC public reporting, DefiLlama stablecoins); rate limits of the futures REST.

fapi_binance_com.transport: REST only, direct fetch, CSP connect-src
fapi_binance_com.cors: LIKELY ALLOWED — same-origin response headers: access-control-allow-origin '*', allow-credentials true, x-mbx-used-weight-1m present. Cross-origin fetch from https://example.com failed, but data-api.binance.vision failed the same way from that page (pane limitation), so inconclusive. Fallback if a build-time probe from the app origin fails: a same-origin rewrite like Coins.ph (not built).

rate_limits_documented.request_weight_ip: 2400 per minute (REQUEST_WEIGHT, interval MINUTE, intervalNum 1: the example in the exchangeInfo response; the live value is the rateLimits array of /fapi/v1/exchangeInfo, not fetched from here)

weights.fundingRate: no weight stated; shares 500 requests / 5 min / IP with /fapi/v1/fundingInfo

rate_limits_documented.futures_data: /futures/data/* (openInterestHist, globalLongShortAccountRatio, takerlongshortRatio): IP rate limit 1000 requests / 5 min; latest 30 days (openInterestHist: latest 1 month) only; limit default 30, max 500
rate_limits_documented.ban: 429 on violation, then HTTP 418 IP ban scaling from 2 minutes to 3 days for repeat offenders; limits are per IP

fapi_binance_com.gate_chosen: one venue gate 'binance-fut': 400 requests per 300 s = 80 % of the strictest documented limit (500 per 5 min on fundingRate); 80 % of 1000 per 5 min is 800 and 80 % of 2400 weight per minute is 1920, both far above it. 429/418 -> RateLimitError and the 'binance-fut' cooldown (Retry-After, else 600 s for 418 and 60 s for 429).
